headline: Microsoft announces Windows and Surface event for October 7th
summary: Microsoft is holding a major event on October 7th in San Francisco. The company will unveil the future of Windows and Surface devices. Expect insights into how local AI will shape upcoming products.

headline: What if social media isn’t hurting kids?
summary: A new perspective challenges the popular belief that social media is solely responsible for declining teen mental health. It critiques Jonathan Haidt's bestseller, "The Anxious Generation." This article explores alternative factors influencing youth well-being.

headline: Kia’s electric van lineup is getting more interesting with reveal of PV7
summary: Minivans are experiencing a surprising comeback in the US market, with sales up 21% in 2025. Kia is expanding its electric van offerings with the new PV7 model. This move aims to capitalize on renewed interest in versatile family vehicles.

headline: One of the best 3D printers for beginners is almost $100 off
summary: The Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 Combo 3D printer is now on sale for $369, saving almost $100. This capable printer can handle four filament rolls simultaneously. It's an excellent entry point for those new to 3D printing.

headline: Get an Asus ROG Xbox Ally X for $899.99, the Least Expensive of the Ultra Premium Handheld Gaming PCs
summary: The Asus ROG Xbox Ally X is currently available for $899.99. Powered by the Ryzen Z2 Extreme processor, it's a top-tier Windows-based gaming handheld. This deal positions it as the most affordable ultra-premium option in its category.

headline: The Hobbit Illustrated Edition Drops to a New Low Price for Amazon Prime Members
summary: The Illustrated Edition of "The Hobbit" is now available at a record-low price. This special discount is exclusively for Amazon Prime members. It's an ideal opportunity for fans and collectors to acquire the classic book.

headline: Former Tekken Director Katsuhiro Harada Says His Next Game Will Be a ‘Surprise,’ But Not Outside Fans’ Expectations
summary: Katsuhiro Harada, former Tekken franchise director, is developing a new game at his VS Studio. He describes the upcoming title as a "surprise" but within fans' expectations. Further details about the mysterious project are beginning to emerge.

headline: Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 Get Preorder Discounts at Amazon (Out Friday)
summary: Amazon is offering preorder discounts on the new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4. Both models are set to be released this Friday. Shoppers can secure the latest Apple wearables at a reduced price before launch.

headline: Baby 'cot cams' plan after inquiry finds Lucy Letby crimes could have been prevented
summary: Plans for live-streaming "cot cams" in neonatal units will be developed urgently. This follows an inquiry into Lucy Letby's crimes. The report concluded that her actions could have been prevented.

headline: Support acts quit Ed Sheeran tour in support of Macklemore
summary: Several support acts have withdrawn from Ed Sheeran's tour. They did so in solidarity with Macklemore, who was dropped after pro-Palestinian statements. Sheeran denies responsibility for Macklemore's removal from the lineup.

headline: Dan Thomas resigns as Reform Wales leader after arrest on suspicion of assault
summary: Dan Thomas has resigned as leader of Reform Wales following his arrest. He was arrested on suspicion of assault by Gwent Police. Thomas maintains his innocence, stating he has done nothing wrong.

headline: Former England footballer Raheem Sterling admits dangerous driving on motorway before crash
summary: Former England winger Raheem Sterling has admitted to dangerous driving. The admission relates to a motorway incident in May. Sterling crashed his Lamborghini into barriers during the event.
